depictions.name: Tatsuyama Quarry
depictions.text: Tatsuyama Quarry is a stone quarry in southern Kakogawa Estuary in Harima, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke infiltrated the quarry while traveling through Harima.
